title: GST Registration Rules and Threshold Limits
source: CBIC, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
content: Mandatory GST registration is required for businesses whose aggregate annual turnover exceeds prescribed threshold limits. For suppliers of goods in normal category states, the registration threshold is ₹40 lakh annual turnover. For suppliers of services, the threshold is ₹20 lakh turnover. For special category states (such as North-Eastern states), the threshold is ₹10 lakh / ₹20 lakh. Mandatory GST registration without any turnover threshold applies to: businesses making interstate taxable supplies, e-commerce operators, casual taxable persons, non-resident taxable persons, and agents supplying goods on behalf of a taxable person.
